summary: Asus ROG Strix G15 AE 513qy (2021) with AMD Ryzen 9 6900HS processor, Radeon RX 6800M graphics card, 16GB DDR5 RAM, and Windows 10 operating system
detected_fault: Overheating of the processor, specifically the VRMs (Voltage Regulator Modules)
suggested_solution: Disable Memory Integrity on Windows Defender
Install AMD Chipset Drivers from AMD's website
Install Radeon RX 6800M graphics drivers from AMD's website (not ASUS)
Use HWiNFO to monitor temperatures and identify potential issues
Adjust the laptop's energy plan settings to prioritize performance
